user_query: I am planning a surprise party for my sister's graduation. Can you help me find some inspirational quotes and messages about success and achievement? Also, could you check if my sister has a rich menu set on LINE and, if so, retrieve the details of that rich menu?

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of inspirational quotes and messages about success and achievement.
Check if the user’s sister has a rich menu set on LINE.
If a rich menu is found, retrieve the details of that rich menu.
